text: The Reabold Board believes the rejection of the offer by the New Board of Union Jack to be self-serving for and not in the best interests of the company or Union Jack shareholders
Publication of Scheme Document by DNO. The Court and General Meetings to be held on 16 October 2026
The scheme is approved at the Scheme Meeting and remains subject to sanction by the High Court (expected in the first quarter of 2027)
